summary_en: Sandbox Corp., wholly owned by Miyasawa Eiichi (current chairman and 42.27% shareholder), to acquire Digital Hearts Holdings shares at ¥1,060/share. Minimum acquisition 5,922,743 shares (26.56% post-deal). Tender period Aug 7 – Sep 24, 2026 (31 business days). Board recommends shareholder participation. Delisting planned upon completion.
title_en: Notice of Implementation of Management Buyout (MBO) and Recommendation to Tender
translation_en_brief: Digital Hearts Holdings announced on August 6, 2026 that its board has endorsed a management buyout (MBO) structured through Sandbox Corp., a newly formed acquisition vehicle wholly owned by Miyasawa Eiichi, the company's current chairman and largest shareholder (holding 9,425,633 shares, or 42.27% of shares outstanding excluding treasury). Sandbox intends to acquire all Digital Hearts shares (excluding treasury shares and restricted shares held by CEO Tsukushi Toshiya) via public tender offer at ¥1,060 per share. The tender will run from August 7 through September 24, 2026 (31 business days). The minimum acquisition target is 5,922,743 shares, which would result in Sandbox holding 26.56% of shares outstanding post-deal when combined with Miyasawa's existing stake. The board, acting on unanimous approval of independent directors (excluding those with conflicts), unanimously recommends shareholders tender their shares. The transaction is intended to result in delisting of Digital Hearts from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market upon completion.
